title: Bronfman E.L. Rothschild L.P. Has $16.11 Million Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:

Bronfman E.L. Rothschild L.P. lifted its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.1% in the 1st quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The firm owned 95,993 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 1,942 shares during the period. Apple makes up 1.5% of Bronfman E.L. Rothschild L.P.’s portfolio, making the stock its 14th largest holding. Bronfman E.L. Rothschild L.P.’s holdings in Apple were worth $16,106,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other large investors also recently bought and sold shares of the company. Harding Loevner LP increased its stake in Apple by 784,734.3% in the 3rd quarter. Harding Loevner LP now owns 3,296,304 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $188,966,000 after buying an additional 3,295,884 shares in the last quarter. Nomura Asset Management Co. Ltd. increased its stake in Apple by 17.6% in the 3rd quarter. Nomura Asset Management Co. Ltd. now owns 1,456,882 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $224,534,000 after buying an additional 217,640 shares in the last quarter. Beck Capital Management LLC increased its stake in Apple by 45.2% in the 3rd quarter. Beck Capital Management LLC now owns 14,637 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,256,000 after buying an additional 4,557 shares in the last quarter. Crawford Lake Capital Management LLC increased its stake in Apple by 36.7% in the 3rd quarter. Crawford Lake Capital Management LLC now owns 104,216 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $16,062,000 after buying an additional 27,969 shares in the last quarter. Finally, AlphaStar Capital Management LLC purchased a new stake in Apple in the 3rd quarter worth $932,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 58.07% of the company’s stock. A number of equities research analysts have issued reports on AAPL shares. Atlantic Securities reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, May 2nd. UBS Group set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Wednesday, June 13th. Sanford C. Bernstein reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $170.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, April 26th. Royal Bank of Canada set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Monday. Finally, Wells Fargo & Co reiterated a “hold” rating and issued a $195.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, April 24th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have issued a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the company. Apple presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $207.53. Apple opened at $190.58 on Tuesday, MarketBeat Ratings reports. The company has a quick ratio of 1.37, a current ratio of 1.46 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $143.37 and a fifty-two week high of $194.20. The company has a market cap of $953.76 billion, a PE ratio of 20.69, a P/E/G ratio of 1.55 and a beta of 1.24.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm posted $2.10 earnings per share. The company’s revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. sell-side analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 EPS for the current year.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has initiated a stock buyback plan on Tuesday, May 1st that allows the company to buyback $100.00 billion in outstanding shares. This buyback authorization allows the iPhone maker to purchase up to 11.9% of its shares through open market purchases. Shares buyback plans are usually an indication that the company’s leadership believes its stock is undervalued.

Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,433 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,576,971. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this link . The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 192,208 shares of company stock valued at $35,104,302 in the last ninety days. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
